title: Exploded Floor Assembly
description: Real Three.js exploded floor build-up with dimensionally linked finish, screed, slab, service void, and ceiling board.
learningObjectives: Identify the vertical order and physical thickness of common floor assembly layers in 3D.
Distinguish physical build-up from the display-only exploded separation.
Compare solid layer thickness with service-void depth without implying structural or code compliance.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat procedural 3D geometry; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: The existing layer-thickness model is preserved and now drives real Three.js solids plus a non-solid service-void volume. Independent browser, accessibility, and engineering review remain required before approval.

source.reference: 3D replacement of reserved buildings-agent task bld-floor-assembly.
